Ćpaj stajl - Lato w Ghettcie

  • Typography
  • Branding

I used scissors to rip up some Playboy magazines. The images of bodies and underwear seemed like perfect components for this childish, silly-looking illustration of a bloke smashing a cop. This came from my time exploring the hood as a child - making my first tags and scratches, and witnessing clashes between football gangs.
